openItems: the deltoid V on the outer arm is a crease plus a soft ridge — the cap's rings are perpendicular to its axis, so the rim cannot wrap the arm; a real V needs a lower lip solid
the triceps horseshoe is a soft U at 16 sides; the three deltoid flows read as plane changes, not carved heads
the abs' horizontal intersections are still as strong as the vertical separation (three front vertices per side at 24 sides); serratus teeth are sub-visible; obliques a smooth flank
the upper back lacks distinct rhomboid / teres mounds; the rear deltoid covers where teres would sit
the male rectus femoris and vastus medialis are subtle under the frontal key; the gluteal fold is a soft horizontal step
Mrs. Mah's glute pair reads a little pad-like across the shelf row from dead rear; her arms stay at 0.74 of the male's radii
the chest's darkest band is ten points under the godform reference; the lower body's lit strips are regular
the arm's top cap disc shows as a small shelf under the cap's front rim at 3x on the side view
